newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers follow world prices down.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers follow world prices down.

text.p: North American bunker prices felt the pressure of falling European values, trading at lower values early this week in steady trade, players said Tuesday.
"We keep falling off in line with overseas. There is also fear there is a lot product in the market," said one West Coast trader.
ARA bunkers dropped by around $6 a tonne on Thursday, falling through the $100 mark for the first time in five months. The rest of Europe followed.
On the East Coast, New York Harbor 380 CST shed $2 a tonne to between $108 and $109 a tonne, but 180 CST was steady.
